objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level such as code of conduct, travel expenses policy, and ICS policy.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Company-wide or locally defined regulations and instructions that document roles, objectives and framework.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a framework or process sequence with details and responsible persons to achieve objectives.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed work steps, test instructions and compliance criteria for sub-processes with associated forms and checklists.

objs.name: document
objs.description: Electronic document that can be created, edited, released and distributed in the system with versioning and audit trail support.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: The abbreviation code for the document type such as RL for guideline.

attributes.name: cross_client_consecutive_number
attributes.description: A 4-digit number assigned consecutively for each document type across clients.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the document such as editing, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which the document is no longer valid.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other master data or documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT systems or applications relevant to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document applies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group or persons authorized to view the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: User responsible for creating and signing the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional users with change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: User responsible for checking technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: User responsible for translating the document into other languages.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons to be notified by email upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to confirm acknowledgement of the document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and released directly via properties switches.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and has an effect on the main document version.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Suggestion for amendment to an existing document that can be created by employees with author rights.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to check if a document should be extended, revised, or invalidated.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned roles and permissions.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person with assigned roles and authorizations in the system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Permission to read, write, or delete documents and objects.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to receive document distribution by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Separate instance in a multi-client system where documents can have different visibility.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creating a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Editing the content of a document using office components or editor client.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Setting and updating document metadata and attributes such as title, status, validity dates, and control information.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document to PDF format after saving.

evts.name: submit_document_for_review
evts.description: Initiating the approval workflow by submitting document for creator signature and review.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Checking document content for technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and release of document by assigned releasers with electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Making released document visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Adding a controlled attachment document to a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Adding additional information attachment to a document that is not subject to release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Removing additional information directly from a document without triggering version changes.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creating a suggested amendment to an existing document by authorized author.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Marking a change proposal for implementation which triggers creation of new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Finalizing the editing of a change proposal by document author.

evts.name: trigger_versioning
evts.description: Creating a new document version when changes to content, attributes, or attachments occur.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated creation of request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration.

evts.name: extend_document_validity
evts.description: Approving and extending document validity by updating valid until date by default period.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creating new version of document when revisions are needed during validity extension check.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creating request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: declare_document_out_of_force
evts.description: Invalidating document and revoking all user authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawing authorizations and archiving invalidated document for defined retention period.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creating request by Business Admin group to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validating archived document and creating new version with retained metadata and properties.

evts.name: assign_distribution_by_email
evts.description: Adding user groups or persons to distribution list for email notification on document release.

evts.name: assign_distribution_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Adding user groups or persons to distribution list requiring acknowledgement confirmation.

evts.name: send_distribution_email_notification
evts.description: Notifying assigned users and user groups by email when new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement_confirmation
evts.description: Requesting recipients to actively confirm acknowledgement of released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirming receipt and acknowledgement of released document version.

evts.name: create_translation
evts.description: Translating released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Checking translated document version for accuracy and completeness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approving and releasing translated document version for visibility to authorized readers.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specifying which clients can view a document in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: Attachment is a controlled document automatically released with the main document.
Additional information is supplementary material attached to a document.
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed in a document.
Validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
Override request references a document to be invalidated.
Reactivation request selects a previously invalidated document for reactivation.
Document can reference other documents through the references attribute.
Document reader attribute assigns user groups with read authorization.
Distribution list contains assigned user groups for document distribution.
Distribution list contains assigned persons for document distribution.
Document visibility is specified for each client in a multi-client system.

Document is converted to PDF format.
Document is submitted for creator signature and review workflow.
Document content is checked by reviewers.
Document is approved and released by releasers with signature.
Document is made visible to authorized readers.
Attachment is created and added to the document.
Attachment is marked for archiving.
Additional information is added to the document.
Additional information is removed from the document.
Change proposal is created for the document.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Change proposal editing is completed.
New document version is created.
Validity extension request is generated for the document.
Document validity is extended.
Document is revised and new version is created.
Override request is created for the document.
Document is invalidated and declared out of force.
Document is archived after invalidation.
Reactivation request is created for the document.
Document is reactivated from archive.
Distribution list is assigned for email notifications.
Distribution list is assigned for acknowledgement requirements.
User receives email notification of released document.
User is requested to confirm acknowledgement of document.
User confirms acknowledgement of released document.
Translation of document is created.
Translated document is reviewed.
Translated document is released.
Client visibility is set for the document.
